title: Reproduce NASA's 2024 Record: How Warm Was Earth?
subject: Climate Science
summary: Use NASA GISTEMP v4 monthly data to reproduce the published 2024 global temperature anomaly (1.28 °C above 1951–1980) and the recent warming trend, then apply the same method to an independent dataset (HadCRUT5).
dataset_source: NASA GISS Surface Temperature Analysis v4 (GISTEMP) and Met Office HadCRUT5, via the datasets/global-temp mirror
license: Data: CC-BY-4.0 (datasets/global-temp packaging). Mission text: CC-BY-4.0, Team PJ.
prerequisites: Spreadsheet or Python basics (helpful, not required)
reproduction_scope: Partial: the 2024 global annual mean anomaly and the 1975–2024 linear trend computed from the published monthly global means. The station homogenisation and spatial interpolation steps of GISTEMP are NOT reproduced.
requirements: Any modern browser. A spreadsheet (Google Sheets, Excel, LibreOffice) or Python for the Reproduce and Prove calculations.
review_scope: Reference values recomputed by two independent implementations

datasets.title: GISTEMP v4 global annual anomaly (mean of 12 months), 1880–2025
datasets.source: Derived from reproduce.csv by the mission build script

datasets.title: HadCRUT5 global monthly anomaly, 1850–2025
datasets.unit: °C vs the dataset's own base period
datasets.source: Met Office Hadley Centre / CRU HadCRUT5
